title: Intelligence Brief
headline: MIT CSAIL researchers had a frontier model directly edit Qwen3.5-0.8B's weights with no gradient
subtitle: MIT CSAIL researchers had a frontier model, Subvocal, YC-backed smart glasses, use RF/radar, Anthropic's revised S-1A filing warns that

heroStat.label: points on "Astra can read and write weights to improve Qwen"

insights.text: MIT CSAIL researchers had a frontier model (GPT-6 Astra) directly edit Qwen3.5-0.8B's weights with no gradient descent or training, fixing a reasoning-loop bug by changing just 0.016% of weights and lifting its MATH-500 score from 7.9% to 48.1%.

Subvocal, YC-backed smart glasses, use RF/radar sensing (not cameras) to decode silent, deliberate mouthing into text at a claimed 200+ words per minute — critics flagged cloud-only decoding and no published accuracy numbers.

Anthropic's revised S-1A filing warns that internal estimates for future models indicate they 'may imminently meet' its own definition of recursive self-improvement, while stating no current model has crossed that threshold.

A Tech Policy Press essay argues the SEC should block Anthropic's IPO, citing nearly $900B in disclosed spending commitments against $96B in cash and incomplete audited financials in the registration statement.

Vercel Labs' agent-desktop debuted at GitHub Trending #1 (+2,275 stars today), giving any shell-capable agent computer use on macOS/Windows/Linux via the OS accessibility tree instead of pixel-guessing.
thedotmack/claude-mem's GitHub star velocity re-accelerated to +1,803/day (111,023 total) after Sunday's dip to +1,479/day, now a five-day trending run.

Grok reappeared at #20 in today's Google Play Store top-30, while Gemini, Claude and ChatGPT were all absent — the fifth consecutive day no frontier-lab app has held a stable position across more than two days running.

NVIDIA's open-weight Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe (30B-MoE, 40-language ASR with diarization) and a new realistic TTS model both trended on Hugging Face today, but neither is full-duplex — the voice-tech suspension test this project tracks has now run 13 consecutive misses since August.

takeaway.text: A frontier model editing another model's weights by hand and Anthropic warning it may be nearing self-improvement land on the same day — one a concrete lab result, the other a company's own risk disclosure.
